optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: Only statements traceable to the cited sources are presented as supported; everything else is recorded as unsupported, a gap or a follow-up question.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review required to assess fit for Product Manager, Mobile Savings role.

evidence.text: Ran 24 customer interviews on saving habits with the user researcher and grouped the findings into five opportunity areas on a shared board.
evidence.notes: Direct evidence of discovery and synthesis.

evidence.text: Wrote and ordered the squad backlog each sprint, splitting the savings-goals feature into releasable slices with acceptance criteria.
The former head of product confirmed in writing that the candidate was the product manager for the savings-goals feature from discovery in 2022 to its release in March 2023.
evidence.notes: Confirms leadership but does not explicitly state vision/strategy alignment with senior stakeholders.

missingEvidence: Explicit evidence that the candidate defined the vision and strategy for mobile savings features and aligned senior stakeholders behind it.

evidence.text: Completed consumer-duty assessments with the compliance partner for the savings-goals and round-up features before each release, recording the target-market and fair-value reasoning.
evidence.notes: Shows collaboration with compliance on consumer-duty requirements.

evidence.text: Built adoption dashboards in the product analytics tool that track goal creation, weekly deposits and goal abandonment, split by customer tenure and by whether the round-up feature was switched on.
